summary: Enhance your skills with our Advanced Office Administration course designed for secretaries and administrative professionals.
lede: Advanced office administration helps experienced support staff coordinate complex workflows, records, schedules, and executive priorities. For administrative assistants, secretaries, and office coordinators, it builds practical skills in mapping service workflows, organizing SharePoint records, coordinating Outlook and Teams meetings, creating Excel workload dashboards, and setting up approval processes, with exercises in executive reporting and continuity planning.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already handle core administrative duties and now need stronger systems, controls, and digital workflows for complex office environments.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in secretarial, executive assistant, office coordination, business support, or administrative operations. Familiarity with Microsoft Outlook and basic Microsoft Excel is useful, but advanced spreadsheet or automation experience is not required. No coding or programming is required for completion. Advanced digital concepts such as Power Automate, SharePoint governance, and AI-assisted administrative analysis are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level. Bring representative, anonymized workflow examples if available; do not bring confidential personal or organizational data.
